description: Submit the property facts the user confirmed and request quotes from DwellQuote's carriers. Send every field the user confirmed, not only the ones they changed. Call this once per quote; then poll get_quotes.

aggressive_dog_breed.description: Any dog of a breed carriers consider aggressive

burglar_alarm.description: Burglar alarm. Values: none (None), central (Central station), direct (Direct to police), local (Local alarm), smart (Smart device)

construction_type.description: Exterior wall construction. Values: stucco_on_frame (Stucco on frame), wood_frame (Wood frame), brick_veneer (Brick-veneer), solid_brick (Solid brick), cement_fiber_siding (Cement fiber siding), vinyl_siding (Vinyl siding), wood_siding (Wood siding), stone_on_frame (Stone on frame), aluminum_siding (Aluminum siding), solid_logs (Solid logs), steel (Steel)

dog_has_bite_history.description: Any dog with a bite history

fire_alarms.description: Fire alarm. Values: none (None), central (Central station), direct (Direct), local (Local alarm), smart (Smart device)

foundation_type.description: Foundation type. Values: slab (Slab), crawl_space (Crawl space), basement (Basement), piers (Pier and beam), suspended_over_hillside (Suspended over hillside)

garage_capacity.description: Garage size; required unless the garage type is none or detached. Values: 1_car (1 car), 2_car (2 car), 3_car (3 car)

garage_structure_type.description: Garage type. Values: none (None), attached (Attached), built_in (Built-in), detached (Detached), basement (Basement), carport (Carport)

gated_community.description: Gated community. Values: no (No), yes_with_guard (Yes with guard), yes_without_guard (Yes without guard)

interior_build_quality.description: Interior finish quality. Values: standard (Standard), semi_custom (Semi-custom), custom (Custom), designer (Designer)

number_of_dogs.description: Number of dogs living at the home

occupancy_type.description: How the home is used. Values: owner_occupied (Owner occupied), rental_property (Rental property), vacant (Vacant), under_construction (Under construction)

residence_type.description: Type of home. Values: single_family (Single family residence), multi_family (Multi-family), condo (Condo), mobile_home (Mobile home)

roof_shape.description: Roof shape. Values: gable (Gable), hip (Hip), flat (Flat), other (Other)

roof_type.description: Roof material. Values: composition (Composition shingles), asphalt (Asphalt), architectural_shingles (Architectural shingles), fiberglass (Fiberglass), concrete_tile (Concrete tile), clay_tile (Clay tile), tar_and_gravel (Tar and gravel), single_ply_membrane (Single-ply membrane), foam (Foam), metal (Metal), wood_shake (Wood shake), wood_shingle (Wood shingle), other (Other)

roof_update_year.description: Year the roof was installed or last replaced

sprinkler_system.description: Fire sprinkler system. Values: none (None), full (Full), partial (Partial)

name: submit_property_details
title: Submit property details and request quotes
